sonnet.problem: The fill-in-the-blank asks the baker to supply a word from the verse's wording ('dressed in ___ apparel'). Nothing on the earlier cards lets the baker reason out 'foreign', so it is a guess at the next words of a line.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.

sonnet.problem: The blank asks the baker to guess a detail of the verse ('search Jerusalem with ___'). Nothing earlier lets the baker reason out 'lamps', so it is a guess at wording the baker hasn't seen.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.

sonnet.problem: Verse 11 ('Wail, O dwellers of the Hollow') comes after the closing quotation mark of 'declares the LORD' in verse 10, and the text doesn't name the speaker. The card says 'the LORD tells the dwellers of the Hollow to wail', which guesses a speaker.
sonnet.rule: When the text doesn't say who is speaking, he doesn't guess. He uses a plain lead-in, like "Then the psalm says…", and names a speaker only when the passage or its heading does.

sonnet.problem: Verse 14 speaks of the Day of the LORD in the third person and doesn't name a speaker. The card says 'Then the LORD says the great Day of the LORD is near', which guesses the speaker. Stop 1 card 10 treated the similar verse 7 as a shifted voice without naming one.
sonnet.rule: When the text doesn't say who is speaking, he doesn't guess. He uses a plain lead-in, like "Then the psalm says…", and names a speaker only when the passage or its heading does.
